lines: English and Cultural Studies - Faculty of Arts and Social Science

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including 1.0 course from English, plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.
1.0 course: English 2230F/G, English 2265F/G (mandatory in second year).
4.0 courses: English 2228F/G, English 2229F/G, English 2695E, English 3333E, English 3771E.
1.0 course in English at the 3000 level or above.
1.0 course in English at the 4000 level.
0.5 course from: English 2362F/G, English 2363F/G, English 2715F/G, English 2735F/G, English 3215F/G, English 3250F/G, English 3478F/G, English 3573F/G, English 3695F/G, English 3913F/G.
2.0 additional courses in English at the 2200 level or above. Up to 1.0 course may be substituted from any 2000-2199 level English essay course.
